title: Identify alternate constructor compact callers
changes: Identify ten unowned compact OBJ roots with explicit selectors passed to the previously authenticated alternate constructor.
validation: Wine bounded source query and reviewed original disassemblies identify 12 selector values and 1,818 nonoverlapping source bytes; existing owners excluded.
limitations: Conditional source only: extraction, runtime, other callers and selectors, ordinary reachability, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance or space measurements.
